title: PixelKin - Jest-House Battle (Clowning Around)
_note: The Old Light's battle cue (every fight on pearlmoor_oldlight_1..6 + _top that has no theme of its own, via maps.ts battle_music). It is the Wild Battle (Dusk Duel) clowning around: the SAME A-minor riff note for note (bars 1-16, so it reads as the fight you know), but as a circus gallop at 168: oom-pah bass on 1 and 3 with brass pah-stabs on the offbeats of 2 and 4, a calliope arp on top, claps on the backbeat, a tritone bicycle-horn honk at the top of each section, slide whistles up and down every 4 bars, the tower's pulse12 'ha-ha' laugh glides in the gaps of bars 4 and 12, and a ba-dum pfft + bell ding closing each 8-bar half. The B-section keeps the heroic C-major lift. Bar 16 walks the bass E-G#-B-E back into bar 1. 168 BPM, A minor, 16 bars (~23 s). snes register on the chip engine; classic-only like every battle cue.
key: A minor (harmonic-minor dominant), lifting to C major
